script: Honestly, labs is such bullshit. What lab? Why are we calling it a lab? It is a trillion-dollar corporation with five thousand people building a superweapon in secrecy, dropping hints from time to time. DeepSeek is a lab. This is a ticking time bomb. Imagine if Los Alamos were a private actor, guarding its cute know-hows, never publishing anything. But that is exactly what they say it is. And I don't see how a nation-state lets that be anything more than a facade, in the long run.
